full_name: Amy Moran-Thomas | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2026–2027 Social Sciences Maury Green Fellow Massachusetts Institute of Technology
bio: Amy Moran-Thomas is an anthropologist of medicine, health, and science at MIT who focuses on how technologies and altered ecologies are designed and come to be materially embodied—often inequitably—by people in their ordinary lives.
